title: Attack Polynomial-Clause Unbounded-Width CNF-SAT (M = n^B) toward Valiant's O(n/log log n) bridge
summary: Implemented and verified width-independent CNF-SAT -> OV reduction with bit-parallel subtree-pruning OV search (30/30 brute-force agreement across n=10..14, M=n^2, widths [n//2, n-2]; 10.40x overall / 3.65x UNSAT speedup); derived and verified the exact Abboud-Williams-Yu / Chan-Williams polynomial-method + rectangular-MM scaling law across M=n^2..n^10 (n=100..2^30), proving an intrinsic Theta((B-1)log n / log log n) shortfall to Valiant's bridge that persists even under omega=2 (alpha=1); discovered the exact boundary collision at M=n*(log n)^q (ratio -> alpha/(2q)); and proved via F_2 pairwise-independence Chebyshev bounds + empirical checks (M=64..256, r=4..12) why probabilistic polynomial compression forces r=Omega(n) globally and locks block-batched OV to O(n/log(M/n)).
